useful_conditional_question: Limited whole-RNA disease representation can inform including native EMC cultures for a specified prospective NR4A3-program RNA perturbation experiment, not predict perturbation response/dependency/protein or universal model suitability.
scientific_value: Potentially useful beyond old target markers and same-donor fidelity, but no new contribution has been demonstrated. Published PDC/TCGA comparisons and known generic culture adaptation remain strong prior-art/alternative checks.
blockers: Actual duplicate/missing processed-column source identity and source-only generic comparators
Compatible annotation/units/normalization and native tissue mixture versus cultured malignant cells
All-native culture/donor/condition coverage and independent novelty/decisive control plan
reopening: Actual public source manifest resolves all processed columns and authenticated culture-control identities, with all native conditions retained. Then freeze a defensible relative native-versus-cultured disease-state statistic and culture/capture/mixture sensitivity with explicit experiment-selection consequence; independent source/novelty review and lead approval required before numeric stage.
not_reopening: Availability correction alone, renamed similarity metric, favorable model/target subset or generic purity exclusion; no old chemokine/IR/APA/DLK1/TMEM266 rescue.
limits: No biological absence, discovery, campaign exhaustion, universal protein requirement or universal same-donor requirement. Earlier freezes byte immutable.
